rationale: The workflow already implements the two applicable optimizations from the evidence: dependency caching is present via setup-uv with enable-cache and cache-dependency-glob covering docs/requirements.txt and the workflow file (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE), and superseded-run cancellation is present via concurrency with cancel-in-progress for non-main branches grouped by workflow and ref (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE). The remaining candidate, P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (add timeout-minutes to the single preview job), has measured evidence in a different single-job workflow but its precondition—representative successful-duration history—is not met here; the CI history is labeled not_a_measured_baseline and gives no reliable job durations. Arbitrarily imposing a timeout on a job that installs torch and renders Quarto docs risks false timeouts on valid slow/cold runs, violating the contraindication and the requirement to preserve build coverage. No other pattern fits: there is no matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST), no schedule to suppress (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE/P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE), no Bazel (P-LIT-BAZEL-*), no test selection/prioritization step, and no unused output to remove. Therefore no supported, safe change is indicated.
